summary: Alpha Compute Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release announcing a $32.2 million two-year compute off-take agreement with an unnamed AI research lab for 504 NVIDIA B200 GPUs. The deal provides $16.1 million in annual recurring revenue with a $7.5 million upfront payment. This is a routine commercial contract, not a special situation. No equity or corporate structure changes are involved. The filing is a standard current report of a material contract, not triggering any special-situations category.
